security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown formatting, documented CLI examples, expected local file writes, and validation text. Two OCR setup commands are confirmed because they ask users to run sudo apt-get install. No evidence of prompt injection, data exfiltration, network access, or malicious intent was found.

remediation.suggestion: Move sudo apt-get commands into clearly manual setup documentation and state that agents must not run them automatically. Offer container or user-managed installation alternatives.

remediation.issue: Referenced helper scripts are not included
remediation.suggestion: Either add the referenced fill, extract, merge, split, and validation scripts or label those sections as examples. This prevents users from running unreviewed replacements.

remediation.issue: Example workflows write to caller-controlled output paths
remediation.suggestion: Normalize output paths, restrict writes to an intended output directory, and avoid deriving filenames directly from untrusted form data.

content.user_title: Process PDFs with Forms, Tables, and OCR
content.value_statement: Complex PDF workflows often need form fields, table extraction, OCR, and validation. This skill provides documented workflows and scripts for reliable PDF processing.
actual_capabilities: Runs scripts/analyze_form.py to inspect PDF form fields and produce JSON or summary output.
Documents form filling, flattening, validation, and batch submission workflows.
Provides table extraction recipes with CSV, Excel, and JSON export patterns.
Explains OCR setup with Tesseract, pdf2image, PIL preprocessing, and language selection.
Shows batch processing, exit code handling, logging, and validation patterns for PDF pipelines.
limitations: Only scripts/analyze_form.py is present; other referenced scripts are examples or expected extensions.
OCR requires external Tesseract and Python packages installed by the user.
Extraction quality depends on PDF structure, scan quality, form type, and table layout.
Examples write local output files, so users must choose safe output paths.

use_cases.title: Map PDF Form Fields
use_cases.description: Inspect a form template and list fields, types, required status, values, and positions before automation.

use_cases.title: Extract Report Tables
use_cases.description: Convert tables in recurring PDF reports into structured CSV, Excel, or JSON outputs for review.

use_cases.title: Build Batch Document Pipelines
use_cases.description: Plan repeatable workflows for OCR, form validation, output files, logging, and error handling.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a PDF Form
prompt_templates.prompt: Use pdf-processing-pro to analyze my PDF form. List the fields, required fields, field types, and any validation concerns.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Tables for Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Use pdf-processing-pro to plan table extraction from this report. Recommend extraction settings, output format, and validation checks.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare OCR Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use pdf-processing-pro to design an OCR workflow for scanned PDFs. Include preprocessing, language settings, quality checks, and output review steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Batch Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Use pdf-processing-pro to design a batch PDF pipeline. Include input validation, safe output paths, logging, retries, exit codes, and human review points.

output_examples.input: Analyze application_template.pdf before automating form completion.
output_examples.output: Form analysis summary with total fields, field types, required fields, read-only fields, and fields that already contain values.

output_examples.input: Extract tables from a monthly finance report.
output_examples.output: Table extraction plan with detection strategy, export format, cleanup steps, and validation checks for totals and missing cells.

output_examples.input: Process scanned invoices with OCR and save reviewable text.
output_examples.output: OCR workflow with image preprocessing, language selection, confidence review, output file naming, and manual verification steps.

best_practices: Validate input PDFs and form data before writing any output files.
Keep original PDFs separate from generated files and use clear output directories.
Review OCR and table extraction results before using them in records or automation.
anti_patterns: Do not assume every referenced helper script exists without checking the repository.
Do not process confidential PDFs without approved storage, retention, and access controls.
Do not trust OCR or table extraction output without validation against the source document.

faq.question: Does this skill include runnable scripts?
faq.answer: It includes scripts/analyze_form.py. Other scripts are referenced as workflow examples and may need to be created.

faq.question: Can it process scanned PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes, the documentation explains OCR workflows using Tesseract, pdf2image, and PIL preprocessing.

faq.question: Can it extract tables from PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes, it provides table extraction guidance and export patterns for CSV, Excel, and JSON.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes, the report marks compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I check before production use?
faq.answer: Check dependencies, script availability, PDF quality, output paths, logging, and validation rules.

faq.question: Are privileged installs required?
faq.answer: OCR may require Tesseract system packages. Install them manually only after reviewing the commands and source.
